Hi Alex — thanks for sending these over and for the clear summary. I received the two attachments and I looped in Sales (Marissa) and Legal (Rishi) to kick off intake. Quick answers up front:

1) Legal review owner: Rishi (cc'd) will lead the redline review and propose edits.
2) Party/PO info we need to populate the Order Form: full legal entity name for billing, billing address, PO contact (name/email/phone), tax ID (if applicable), and whether the contract should be with CloudWave Analytics, CloudWave, Inc., or a regional subsidiary.
3) SOC 2 / security evidence: helpful but not required to start the legal review — please share SOC 2 Type II report or a link to your security portal if available.

To make the review faster I've attached our standard intake template (Redwood_intake_template.xlsx) — if you can fill the fields under "Billing & Party Details" that will let us draft a clean Order Form.

Next steps I propose:
- You fill the intake template and return it (or confirm party info inline).
- Rishi will do an initial redline pass and return questions/alternate language within 48 hours.
- If there are open commercial issues (pricing, billing entity), Marissa will coordinate a short call.

If tomorrow morning 9–10am PT works, Marissa and I can join that sync to go over commercial and intake items.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz

Looping in Rishi to prioritize legal review. Vanessa — FYI commercial is straightforward: pilot for 3 months, $25k committed, then conversion to monthly. Two quick flags from my side:
- Pricing and billing entity need to be finalized before a PO is issued.
- The customer asked for EU processing; we should confirm which services would need region restrictions.

Rishi — can you please review the redlines Alex shared and flag any blocking R clauses (indemnity, data retention/audit, and export controls)? If we can get a reply today or tomorrow morning, I can schedule the commercial sync.

Marissa
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@cloudwave.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: initial intake and redlines

Hi Alex — thanks for the redlines and the clear summary. I reviewed CloudWave_MSA_Redlines_v1.docx and put initial positions in the attached RW_Redlines_v1.docx (track changes). High-level:

- Data residency: we can accept a regionally scoped processing clause for EU user data but will need to limit it to the services/subset in the Order Form and include a route for SSR (secure remote replication) for DR.
- Retention & preservation: we cannot agree to indefinite preservation. Propose a 90-day preservation window for investigatory holds, with an option to extend by mutual agreement.
- Indemnity & cap: we will push back on uncapped indemnities tied to third-party claims; propose a cap equal to the fees paid in the prior 12 months and carve-outs for gross negligence/fraud.
- Audit rights: we will accept a vendor assessment process (SOC 2 report + on-site or remote audit subject to notice and confidentiality) rather than open, unrestricted audits.

I've also attached a clean Order Form template (OrderForm_Clean_Template.docx) that we can pre-populate once you confirm the billing entity and PO contact. Other asks: please provide SOC 2 Type II (if available) and a contact for security questions (email).

Plan: I propose we aim for a joint 30-minute call to walk through the redlines and agree carve-outs. Vanessa/Marissa — if you can confirm commercial points, I'll prepare an initial counter and mark the few non-starters.

Attachments: RW_Redlines_v1.docx, OrderForm_Clean_Template.docx

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
